wiki.title: Kimberly Coates
wiki.extract: Kimberly Landry Coates is an American politician serving as a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives from the 73rd district. A member of the Republican Party, Coates represents parts of Tangipahoa Parish and has been in office since January 8, 2024.
